greeting.text: Hey! You! I'm Leopold Vermillion, and one day I'll be the strongest of the Vermillions!
Are you a delver? Great! Then we're rivals! Don't argue, it's decided.
Welcome to the Sanctuary! Don't worry, I'll show you around. By which I mean I'll show you how strong I am.
You've beaten champions already?! No way! Then I'll train twice as hard!
Rival! You're back! I've been waiting to show you something!
Oh! It's you! Let's spar sometime!

hint.text: Fire gets stronger when you shout! ...That might not be true. But it feels true.
My brother is a captain, my sister is a monster, and I'm just getting started. Watch me.
Rest when you're tired and fight when you're not. Even I figured that one out.
Don't just copy someone's spells. Make them yours! That's what my brother says, anyway.
Warm up before the big fights! A stiff arm is a missed block!
No champion yet? Perfect, we start from the same spot, rival! First to beat a guardian wins! ...You're already ahead. I haven't gone yet.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun are tough, but we're tougher! Don't let their tricks scare you, rival!
Heath Grice is beaten? Ha! I would have done it too, just... later!
Spade Kingdom! Gravity! If it pushes you down, push back harder! Or just jump!
Lucius is the last big one? I can't wait! Okay, I can wait a little. I'm a bit scared.
Rival, there are fighters in the Chronicle from other worlds! Think how strong they must be! I want to fight them all!

farewell.text: Don't lose to anything without me!
